title: Evaluation of the geometric chart counit on an etale representative
statement: Let R be a finite commutative ring annihilated by N, U and Y Noetherian schemes, e:U→affineTraceTower(Y,d) a separated etale morphism of finite type, and cp,cg the specified compactifications. Fix a normalized chart adjunction datum C as in [lem-sp-chart-finite-ring-adjunction], with its exact site comparisons, quasi-inverse, etale and pro-etale counits, and geometric normalization. For every etale finite-Tor constructible input J, pro-etale input K and isomorphism a:ν_Y^*J≅K, let γ_J be chartGeometryComponent, H the ordered ordinary chart right functor and G the geometric pro-etale chart right functor. The actual counit satisfies F_pro(γ_J followed by G(a)) followed by F_pro(C.geometric_K inverse) followed by C.adjPro.counit_K = c_HJ followed by ν_Y^*(C.adjEt.counit_J) followed by a, where c is the canonical compact-support site comparison of [lem-sf-class-compact-support-comparison]. The finite-Tor full categories and inclusion into D+ are those of [det-sp-et-proet-adjunction-transfer]. This is a single-ring equation and uses no coefficient extension.

source.place: Charts: transport of the actual counit through the normalized site and geometric comparisons

proof.text: Assemble towerENormalForm, tensorEPullback and the inverse-image composition isomorphism to obtain an ordinary natural chart normalization. Compose its site inverse image with the shift comparison, the bifunctor tensor comparison, the single-sheaf comparison and the canonical pullback/site square. The resulting natural isomorphism has components chartGeometryComponent by the explicit definitions. Restrict it to the full constructible domains.

At the comparison image of J, use naturality of the geometric comparison at the inverse equivalence unit and the equivalence triangle equation. Its component is eU(H(unit inverse)) followed by the geometric component at J. Substitute Datum.proCounit and cancel the inverse geometric component and the image of the unit. This leaves cf inverse followed by the comparison image of the actual etale counit.

Use Datum.fixedComparison to identify cf inverse with the exact open comparison and the fixed proper direct-image counit mate. Naturality of rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility, together with restriction of exact functor composition and natural isomorphisms from D to D+, identifies fixedCompactSupportComparisonIso with compactSupportSiteComparison.

Apply naturality of the geometric counit to a after the identity just proved on ν_Y^*J. Full-subcategory inclusions retain the same underlying arrows, so the resulting equation is exactly the displayed ambient equation.

theorem chartGeometricCounitEvaluation
    (R : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing R] [Finite R]
    {U Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian U] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (N : ℕ) (hR : (N : R) = 0) (d : ℕ) (e : U ⟶ affineTraceTower Y d)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.Etale e] [IsSeparated e] [LocallyOfFiniteType e] [QuasiCompact e]
    (cp : Compactification (affineTraceProjection Y d))
    (cg : Compactification (e ≫ affineTraceProjection Y d))
    (M : Etale.EtaleCompactSupportNormalization R)
    (t : Etale.OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport R N hR)
    (P : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      Etale.OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum R N hR t T hT)
    (hY : IsUnit (N : Γ(Y, ⊤))) (C : Datum R N hR d e cp cg M t P hY)
    (J : (etaleProperty R Y).FullSubcategory)
    (K : (proEtaleProperty R Y).FullSubcategory)
    (a : (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) Y).mapDerivedCategory.obj J.obj ≅
      K.obj) :
    (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) cg).map
        ((chartGeometryComponent R N C.positive hR C.flatTwist hY d e J.obj).hom ≫
          (geometricRight R N hR d e).map a.hom) ≫
      (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) cg).map
        (C.geometric.inv.app K).hom ≫ (C.adjPro.counit.app K).hom =
    (compactSupportSiteComparison R cg).hom.app
        ((etaleToPlus R U).obj ((etaleRight R N hR d e C.hRight).obj J)) ≫
      (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) Y).mapDerivedCategory.map
        (C.adjEt.counit.app J).hom ≫ a.hom
